note: Export side is factually confirmed: 5 dated India->Russia air-cargo export B/Ls (9953608, 4796541, 7922212, 7543597, 7248845) from Delhi Air Cargo to Moscow/Mouila, Jan 2025 - Feb 2026, buyer LLC INTERSY (Yekaterinburg). Actual HS codes on the records are 90278990, 38249900 and 39209190 (PVB lamination film, UV testers, chemical preparations) — none of the four declared codes (130232; 840810; 841391; 848310) appears in any observed shipment, so the declared HS set is wrong and should be corrected to the factual codes; per project rule this is not a rejection ground. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts) could not be checked: DuckDuckGo search returned 'Connection refused' on both attempts and volza/eximpedia returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown, not 'none_found'. Revenue/export volume figures are not public on the free view — null, not estimated. Trader/manufacturer role not determinable from shipment data alone; the pattern (buying from LLC INTERSY and shipping back to the same counterparty) suggests trading activity.
